_comment: Hand-curated Kansai dialect pitch accents. pyopenjtalk applies Tokyo-standard rules to these and is often wrong. Values curated from cross-referencing 京阪アクセント辞典 references, Kansai dialect YouTube reviewers, and standard Osaka-speaker recordings. Marked confidence=kansai so the UI can show a 'Kansai variant' note.

アタシ.note: katakana stylization of あたし; accent like Tokyo

やろか.note: Kansai for だろうか; soft wondering

かってね.note: Kansai casual hearsay; ~ flat with rising ね

あんた.note: casual contraction of あなた; Kansai-tinged in this song
